lines.en: label christmastwo18:
I can’t just stay up here.
lines.zh: 我不能就这么待在楼上。

lines.en: But I can’t just get up either.
lines.zh: 但我也不能就这么站起来。

lines.en: Especially not with the weight of years worth of lost time and thousands if not millions of self-inflicted misdirections pressing down upon me.
lines.zh: 尤其是当那些年错失的时光、还有成千上万——如果不是上百万——次自我造成的迷失，全都压在我身上。

lines.en: Niki isn’t the only person who wants to see me right now. That much is an indisputable fact.
lines.zh: Niki 不是此刻唯一想见我的人。这一点是无可争辩的事实。

lines.en: But-
lines.zh: 但是——

lines.en: Right now-
lines.zh: 此刻——

lines.en: She is the one {i}I{/i} want to see.
lines.zh: 她是{i}我{/i}最想见的那个人。

lines.en: Maybe it means something, maybe it doesn’t.
lines.zh: 也许这有意义，也许没有。

lines.en: I’m in no condition to explain it- and I likely won’t be for quite some time.
lines.zh: 我现在没有能力去解释它——而且很可能很长一段时间里都不会有。

lines.en: But I can’t keep her waiting when she’s already waited this long.
lines.zh: 但她已经等了这么久，我不能让她再等下去。

lines.en: : {i}I’m on my way.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我马上过来。{/i}

lines.en: scene black
The walk downstairs is a painful one, and not just because my legs haven’t yet recovered from being tethered to what felt like another dimension.
lines.zh: 下楼的这段路很痛苦，不只是因为我的腿还没从“被拴在另一个维度上”的感觉里恢复过来。

lines.en: It’s painful because even if everything goes perfectly once I make it outside of the hotel, the second I head back in, it will be reduced to fragments once again.
lines.zh: 痛苦在于，即便我走出酒店后一切顺利，等我再回头的那一刻，这一切又会碎成片段。

lines.en: Past or no past, things are different now.
lines.zh: 不管有没有过去，现在的事情已经不一样了。

lines.en: Remembering one thing does not change that.
lines.zh: 想起一件事并不能改变这一点。

lines.en: In fact, up until a few minutes ago, I was under the impression that remembering anything at all could kill me.
lines.zh: 事实上，就在几分钟前，我还以为想起任何东西都可能要我的命。

lines.en: But I feel more alive right now than I have in a long time.
lines.zh: 但我现在比很久以来的任何时候都更有活着的感觉。

lines.en: I just don’t know if that’s good or not.
lines.zh: 我只是不知道这算好还是不好。

lines.en: My phone goes off again...probably because Niki is tired of waiting and-
lines.zh: 我的手机又响了……大概是因为 Niki 等得不耐烦了，然后——

lines.en: Oh.
lines.zh: 哦。

lines.en: Apparently it’s something else.
lines.zh: 看来是别的事。

lines.en: : {i}Hey. It’s Maya. Where are you?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嘿。我是 Maya。你在哪儿？{/i}

lines.en: Thankfully, this seemingly endless loop of stairs gives me enough time to respond without a fiery pink haired girl clapping back at me for not paying enough attention to her.
lines.zh: 幸好这段仿佛没有尽头的楼梯给了我足够的时间回复，不用被一个火红头发的姑娘因为我不够关注她而反呛一顿。

lines.en: : {i}I didn’t realize you had my number.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我不知道你有我的号码。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I’ve had it this whole time. I just didn’t want you bothering me more than you already do.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我一直都有。只是不想让你比现在更烦我。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Fair enough. But why do you want to know where I am?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}说得也是。不过你为什么想知道我在哪儿？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Because I want to see you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}因为我想见你。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Can you come up to the roof? I’ll be there shortly. I just have to do something else first.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你能上天台来吗？我很快就到。我得先去做另一件事。{/i}

lines.en: Did Maya just...actually say she wants to see me?
lines.zh: Maya 刚刚……真的说了她想见我？

lines.en: There’s way too much happening all of a sudden. So much that I’m starting to question exactly how much of tonight has even been real.
lines.zh: 突然之间发生的事太多了。多到我开始怀疑今晚到底有多少是真的。

lines.en: : {i}Didn't you say the roof was closed earlier?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你之前不是说天台关着吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It was.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是关着。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I guess someone must have unlocked it. I don't know. Are you coming or not?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我猜有人把它打开了。我不知道。你到底来不来？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Sure. But I also have to do something else first.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}来。不过我也得先去做另一件事。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}That’s fine. See you there.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}行。那儿见。{/i}

lines.en: My phone goes back into my pocket.
lines.zh: 手机回到我的口袋里。

lines.en: My legs go back to work.
lines.zh: 双腿重新开工。

lines.en: $ mayanumber = True
scene nikilove1
I find Niki and-
lines.zh: 我找到了 Niki，然后——

lines.en: : I love you, okay?!
lines.zh: : 我爱你，好吗？！

lines.en: And {i}that{/i} happens.
lines.zh: 然后{i}这件事{/i}就发生了。

lines.en: : I know that Noriko gave you all of my letters and I want you to know that-
lines.zh: : 我知道 Noriko 把我所有的信都给了你，我想让你知道——

lines.en: : Niki-
lines.zh: : Niki-

lines.en: : Shut the fuck up and let me finish!
lines.zh: : 闭上你他妈的嘴，让我说完！

lines.en: : I know that you probably think I’m insane for waiting for you for so long and, you know what?! Maybe I am!
lines.zh: : 我知道你大概觉得我等了你这么久是疯了，而且你知道吗？！也许我就是疯了！

lines.en: : But I never stopped thinking about you! Even when I dedicated my entire fucking life to making it so you could never run away from me ever again!
lines.zh: : 但我从来没有停止过想你！哪怕我把整整一辈子都他妈的用来确保你再也逃不出我的手掌心！

lines.en: : I wanted to follow you everywhere! And since I couldn’t do it in person, I did it through the radio! TV! Billboards! Everything!
lines.zh: : 我想跟着你去任何地方！既然不能亲自做到，我就通过电台！电视！广告牌！一切！

lines.en: : I wanted to be there every second of your miserable fucking life because I can’t stand the thought of mine without you!
lines.zh: : 我想在你那悲惨的、他妈的一生的每一秒里都在场，因为我无法忍受没有你的人生！

lines.en: scene nikilove2
: Look at me! I’m screaming my fucking lungs out on Christmas in some random ass hotel where I could get caught at any second! And I don’t care!
lines.zh: : 看着我！我在圣诞节里把肺都他妈的喊出来了，就在这么个随随便便的破酒店，随时可能被人撞见！而我不在乎！

lines.en: : I don’t care if anyone sees this and posts it on the fucking Internet or tries to blackmail me or anything! I literally don’t care!
lines.zh: : 我不在乎有没有人看到这一幕然后发到他妈的网上，或者试图勒索我什么的！我真的不在乎！

lines.en: : I feel like that’s something you’ll wind up regretting once you’ve actually thought about it rationally.
lines.zh: : 我觉得等你真正理性地想过之后，大概会后悔说这些。

lines.en: : You’re not fucking getting it. I {i}can’t{/i} think about anything rationally anymore.
lines.zh: : 你他妈的根本没懂。我已经{i}再也没法{/i}理性地思考任何事了。

lines.en: : You ripped my heart and my mind to shreds and becoming...{i}this?{/i} This is just the glue I used to put it all back together.
lines.zh: : 你把我的心和我的脑子撕成了碎片，而变成……{i}这样？{/i}这只是我用来把它们粘回去的胶水。

lines.en: : It doesn’t look the same. It doesn’t feel the same. Literally {i}nothing{/i} about it is the same and it’s because I {i}know{/i} now that I can never be {i}me{/i} without {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 它看起来不一样了。摸起来也不一样了。关于它的{i}每一点{/i}都不一样了，因为我现在{i}知道{/i}了，没有{i}你{/i}，我永远无法成为{i}我自己{/i}。

lines.en: scene nikilove3
: Come home.
lines.zh: : 回家吧。

lines.en: : Come be with me.
lines.zh: : 回来和我在一起。

lines.en: : Come stay in fancy hotels and eat junk food and watch Gunfighter Z until we pass out.
lines.zh: : 回来住豪华酒店、吃垃圾食品、看 Gunfighter Z 直到我们睡着。

lines.en: : It’ll be exactly the same as it used to be, just...not in my parents’ house. Which I think is a pretty sweet improvement since all they ever did was get in the way anyway.
lines.zh: : 一切都会和以前一模一样，只是……不在我爸妈的房子里。我觉得这算是个相当不错的改进，反正他们只会碍事。

lines.en: : Niki-
lines.zh: : Niki-

lines.en: : I love you. More than you can ever fucking imagine. I love you so much.
lines.zh: : 我爱你。比你他妈能想象到的还要爱。我太爱你了。

lines.en: : I know you do.
lines.zh: : 我知道你爱。

lines.en: : I finally remembered something a few minutes ago when I was reading your letters.
lines.zh: : 几分钟前我读你的信的时候，终于想起了一些事。

lines.en: scene nikilove4
: What? Really? What was it?
lines.zh: : 什么？真的？是什么？

lines.en: : Just a random night.
lines.zh: : 只是某个普通的夜晚。

lines.en: : We were in your room on Christmas watching that same anime you just mentioned.
lines.zh: : 我们在你房间里过圣诞，看的就是你刚提到的那部动画。

lines.en: : Your parents were having a party downstairs and-
lines.zh: : 你爸妈在楼下开派对，然后——

lines.en: : That was the first night we kissed.
lines.zh: : 那是我们第一次接吻的夜晚。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Yeah. You teased me about blushing and I got really embarrassed and spent the rest of the night trying to prove that I didn’t think of you that way.
lines.zh: : 嗯。你取笑我脸红，我非常难为情，然后一整晚都在努力证明我没有那样想过你。

lines.en: : I failed miserably.
lines.zh: : 我失败得惨不忍睹。

lines.en: : Yeah...it sounds like it.
lines.zh: : 是啊……听起来的确是。

lines.en: scene nikilove5
: So {i}that’s{/i} what you remembered before anything else, huh?
lines.zh: : 所以你最先想起来的就是{i}这个{/i}啊？

lines.en: : I always figured that since we didn’t really {i}get together{/i} until way later that...you had kind of just...forgotten about it.
lines.zh: : 我一直以为，既然我们是很久以后才真正{i}在一起{/i}的，那你大概早就……把它忘了。

lines.en: : Well, you {i}did{/i} forget about it. But I’m talking about, like...{i}before{/i} you...
lines.zh: : 嗯，你{i}确实{/i}忘了。但我是说，比如……在你……{i}之前{/i}。

lines.en: : God, we’re so fucking old now.
lines.zh: : 天啊，我们现在真他妈的老了。

lines.en: scene black
Niki shows no sign of stopping anytime soon and moves closer to me.
lines.zh: Niki 完全没有要停下来的迹象，又朝我靠近了一些。

lines.en: I haven’t been able to really get any words in, but I figure that might be for the best since anything I could possibly say right now would just crush her feelings as if they were an insect underfoot.
lines.zh: 我一直没能真正插上话，但我想这样也许最好，因为此刻我可能说出口的任何话，都会像踩死一只虫子一样碾碎她的感情。

lines.en: I don’t want to do that to her.
lines.zh: 我不想对她做那种事。

lines.en: Especially not when the vast majority of insects die in less than a year to begin with.
lines.zh: 尤其是考虑到绝大多数昆虫本来就在一年内死掉。

lines.en: I’ll let this one live for now.
lines.zh: 这一只我先留它一命。

lines.en: It interests me.
lines.zh: 它让我感兴趣。

lines.en: scene nikilove6
: So, uhh...are you going to keep those letters? Because, if I remember correctly, I might have said a lot of really mean stuff in some of them and I’d prefer you didn’t see any of it.
lines.zh: : 那个，呃……你打算留着那些信吗？因为如果我没记错的话，我在其中几封里可能说了不少很恶毒的话，我更希望你看不到。

lines.en: : You say a lot of really mean stuff in person, too. I doubt it would affect me all that much.
lines.zh: : 你当面也说了不少很恶毒的话。我怀疑它们对我影响不了多少。

lines.en: : Well it clearly affects you in {i}some{/i} way, seeing as they helped chip away at that {i}amnesia{/i} of yours.
lines.zh: : 嗯，它们显然在{i}某种{/i}程度上影响了你，毕竟它们帮你敲掉了一点{i}失忆{/i}。

lines.en: : It’s a little upsetting that the memory didn’t last long enough for me to see that kiss.
lines.zh: : 有点遗憾的是，那段记忆没有持续久到让我看到那个吻。

lines.en: : What kind of weirdo wants to watch his younger self kiss a little girl?
lines.zh: : 什么样的变态会想看年轻的自己亲一个小女孩？

lines.en: : I just meant that it might be a nice thing to remember. I didn’t mean it in a weird way.
lines.zh: : 我只是说那也许是件值得记住的好事。我不是那个奇怪的意思。

lines.en: scene nikilove7
: You know we can always just make {i}more{/i} memories, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道我们随时可以制造{i}更{/i}多回忆，对吧？

lines.en: : As great as the old ones are, you can rely on me to fill in the gaps and tell you about all of the important stuff.
lines.zh: : 尽管旧回忆很好，你可以放心让我来填补空白，把所有重要的事都告诉你。

lines.en: : I’ll say it again. {i}Be{/i} with me. For real this time.
lines.zh: : 我再说一次。{i}和我在一起{/i}。这次是认真的。

lines.en: : We’re not awkward teenagers anymore. We can do it right this time.
lines.zh: : 我们不再是别扭的青少年了。这次我们可以做对。

lines.en: : What happened to not wanting a relationship?
lines.zh: : “不想要一段关系”那套怎么说来着？

lines.en: : What {i}happened{/i} is I stopped lying to myself.
lines.zh: : {i}那套{/i}是因为我不再对自己撒谎了。

lines.en: : Noriko helped push me in the right direction as well which, honestly, I was not expecting at all.
lines.zh: : Noriko 也帮了忙，把我推向了正确的方向，说实话，这完全出乎我的意料。

lines.en: : I really thought she was going to go all-in on winning you over in my place.
lines.zh: : 我还真以为她会全力以赴，替我把你抢走。

lines.en: : And, all things considered, I’m glad she didn’t because I would have broken her fucking neck.
lines.zh: : 而综合来看，我很高兴她没有，因为那样我会把她他妈的脖子拧断。

lines.en: : Aren’t idols...not allowed to date, though?
lines.zh: : 不过偶像……不是不能谈恋爱吗？

lines.en: scene nikilove8
: Nope. So either I can be an extremely rare exception to that rule or...I can just graduate.
lines.zh: : 不能。所以要么我成为那条规矩极其罕见的例外，要么……我就直接毕业。

lines.en: : You’re going back to school?
lines.zh: : 你要回学校？

lines.en: : What? No. It’s like the idol version of retiring.
lines.zh: : 什么？不是。那是偶像版的“引退”。

lines.en: : You love your career, though. Why would you give that up?
lines.zh: : 可你热爱你的事业啊。为什么要放弃？

lines.en: : Obviously because there’s something else I love more.
lines.zh: : 显然是因为我还有更爱的东西。

lines.en: : Niki, you-
lines.zh: : Niki，你-

lines.en: scene nikilove9
: The way I look at it is this...
lines.zh: : 我是这么看的……

lines.en: : I became an idol to make you jealous and regretful and, instead, wound up winning over nearly everyone {i}except{/i} you.
lines.zh: : 我当偶像是为了让你嫉妒、让你后悔，结果却赢得了几乎所有人的心，{i}唯独{/i}没赢到你。

lines.en: : You don’t give two shits about how famous I am. So even if I like it, the plan kind of failed.
lines.zh: : 你根本不在乎我有多出名。所以就算我喜欢这份工作，这个计划也算是失败了。

lines.en: : I don’t have to rely on the media to reach you anymore. I can fit your address and contact information in the palm of my hand.
lines.zh: : 我不用再靠媒体来找到你了。你的地址和联系方式，我一只手掌就能装下。

lines.en: scene nikilove10
: So...if you’ll have me again...I’ll give all of that up.
lines.zh: : 所以……如果你还愿意要我的话……我愿意放弃那一切。

lines.en: : I have plenty of money. And my contract with the agency says that I’ll still make royalties even if I’m fired or decide to quit.
lines.zh: : 我有的是钱。而且我和事务所的合同规定，就算我被开除或者主动退出，我照样能拿版税。

lines.en: : Let’s start over.
lines.zh: : 我们重新开始吧。

lines.en: : We were meant for each other. I know it.
lines.zh: : 我们天生一对。我知道的。

lines.en: : Don’t you want that again?
lines.zh: : 你不想再要那种感觉了吗？

lines.en: : Don’t you think that the key to not feeling so empty all the time is to stick with someone who knows what’s missing?
lines.zh: : 难道你不觉得，不再一直感到空虚的秘诀，就是守在一个知道你缺了什么的人身边？

lines.en: : What if I don’t, though?
lines.zh: : 可如果我不这么想呢？

lines.en: scene nikilove11
: What if I don’t think that starting over with you is the right idea? What if I don’t want to {i}be{/i} with you the way you want to be with me?
lines.zh: : 如果我不觉得和你重新开始是个好主意呢？如果我不想像你想要的那样和你{i}在一起{/i}呢？

lines.en: : Then you’re a fucking idiot. I’m a catch. {i}And{/i} I can do that thing with my tongue where-
lines.zh: : 那你就是个他妈的白痴。我可是抢手货。{i}而且{/i}我还会用舌头做那个——

lines.en: : Niki, wait.
lines.zh: : Niki，等等。

lines.en: : Fine. But you know the thing I’m talking about.
lines.zh: : 行吧。但你知道我说的是哪个。

lines.en: : I just...can’t make a change as big as this right now.
lines.zh: : 我只是……现在没法做出这么大的改变。

lines.en: : Then when? Because I want to say I’m not going to wait around forever, but that would obviously be a lie when I am this...well, {i}addicted{/i} to you.
lines.zh: : 那什么时候？我想说我不会永远等下去，但显然那是谎话，毕竟我这么……嗯，对你{i}上瘾{/i}。

lines.en: : I’m a horrible thing to be addicted to.
lines.zh: : 我是种很糟糕的成瘾物。

lines.en: : I sometimes think it would have been safer to just start doing drugs.
lines.zh: : 我有时候觉得，干脆去吸毒反而更安全。

lines.en: : Listen, you-
lines.zh: : 听着，你-

lines.en: scene nikilove12
: No. {i}You{/i} listen!
lines.zh: : 不。{i}你{/i}听着！

lines.en: : I’m obviously not expecting you to drop the whole life you made for yourself out of thin air because I decided to {i}re{/i}-confess...
lines.zh: : 我显然没指望你因为我{i}重{/i}新表白一次，就把你为自己建立的整个人生凭空扔掉……

lines.en: : But I’m throwing out a bunch of ideas because, no matter what happens, I want to be with you!
lines.zh: : 但我抛出一大堆想法，是因为无论发生什么，我都想和你在一起！

lines.en: : That’s all I’ve ever wanted for as long as I’ve known you!
lines.zh: : 从我认识你那天起，这就是我唯一的愿望！

lines.en: : And sure, it was just as friends at first. But I will never, in a million lifetimes, {i}ever{/i} be able to do that again!
lines.zh: : 当然，一开始只是想当朋友。但就算再活一百万辈子，我也{i}再也{/i}做不到那一回了！

lines.en: : Not when I know how fucked up and empty my {i}amazing{/i} life is without you in it.
lines.zh: : 尤其在我知道，没有你的、我那{i}了不起{/i}的人生，有多么糟糕、多么空虚的时候。

lines.en: : I still {i}am{/i} in it, though.
lines.zh: : 可我{i}还是{/i}在你的人生里啊。

lines.en: : Yeah, but you're not in the right fucking place!
lines.zh: : 是啊，但你他妈的不在正确的位置上！

lines.en: : Look at us! Look at who we are on the inside now!
lines.zh: : 看看我们！看看我们现在的里面是什么样！

lines.en: : We’re ugly and empty and lonely and hurting and all of those things were a lot less scary when we had each other to fall back on!
lines.zh: : 我们丑陋、空虚、孤独、遍体鳞伤，而只要有彼此可以依靠，这些东西都没那么可怕！

lines.en: : Let me fall on you again! Be there for me and I’ll be there for you! Until we’re old and jaded and I can’t do the tongue thing anymore!
lines.zh: : 让我再倒回你身上吧！你陪着我，我也陪着你！直到我们都老去、变得愤世嫉俗，直到我的舌头再也做不了那个！

lines.en: : Okay, you really need to stop yelling.
lines.zh: : 好了，你真的得别再喊了。

lines.en: : Then fucking kiss me and {i}make{/i} me stop, damn it! I’ve been waiting for it this entire time!
lines.zh: : 那就他妈的吻我，{i}让{/i}我停下来，该死的！我等这个等了整整这么久！

lines.en: : Niki-
lines.zh: : Niki-

lines.en: : Screw it! I’ll do it myself!
lines.zh: : 管他呢！我自己来！

lines.en: scene nikilove13
Niki pulls herself forward in a violent lunge that manages to transform into a light push at the very last instant.
lines.zh: Niki 猛地向前扑过来，那股凶猛的冲势在最后一刻化作轻轻一推。

lines.en: Her lips press against mine, the same way they did on Christmas night many years ago when we decided to change our relationship forever.
lines.zh: 她的唇贴上我的，就像许多年前那个圣诞夜一样——那晚我们决定永远改变彼此的关系。

lines.en: I wonder if we’d still be standing here today if that never happened.
lines.zh: 我有时会想，如果那件事从未发生，我们今天还会不会站在这里。

lines.en: I wonder if this kiss would feel even half as good as it does without years of history gushing out of it.
lines.zh: 我有时会想，如果没有那么多年的往事从里面涌出来，这个吻会不会连现在一半的美好都没有。

lines.en: Of course I want Niki.
lines.zh: 我当然想要 Niki。

lines.en: In fact, it’s probably one of the things I’m {i}most{/i} certain about right now.
lines.zh: 事实上，这大概是此刻我{i}最{/i}确定的事情之一。

lines.en: But I can’t have her the same way I can have the other girls.
lines.zh: 但我不能像拥有其他女孩那样拥有她。

lines.en: She wants the version of me she grew up with. The one who (At least presumably) sat there listening to her problems and helping her through them when necessary.
lines.zh: 她想要的是她从小一起长大的那个版本的我。那个（至少据推测）会坐在那里听她倾诉、在需要时帮她渡过去的人。

lines.en: She wants the person who helped her discover what it means to love. How it feels to be touched.
lines.zh: 她想要那个帮她发现“爱意味着什么”的人。那个让她知道被触碰是什么感觉的人。

lines.en: She wants someone who doesn’t exist anymore.
lines.zh: 她想要一个已经不存在的人。

lines.en: Why does one measly memory entitle me to that?
lines.zh: 为什么区区一段记忆，就让我有资格被那样对待？

lines.en: scene nikilove14
: Are we really not getting back together? Because, maybe I’ve just been reading too much manga, but this played out a little differently in my head.
lines.zh: : 我们真的不能复合吗？因为，也许是我漫画看太多了，但这一段在我脑子里演的可不是这样。

lines.en: : Did you think you were just going to confess out of the blue like that and that we’d ride off into the sunset together?
lines.zh: : 你以为你会就这么突然表白，然后我们就一起奔向夕阳？

lines.en: : Obviously not. It’s night time. The sun has already set.
lines.zh: : 显然不是。现在是晚上。太阳早就落了。

lines.en: : You know what I mean.
lines.zh: : 你知道我什么意思。

lines.en: : Besides, I already knew you felt this way. Maybe not in as much detail, but I still knew.
lines.zh: : 再说，我早就知道你是这么想的。也许没这么详细，但我确实知道。

lines.en: : I just...don’t really understand why. Do you...not see me that way anymore or something?
lines.zh: : 我只是……真的不明白为什么。你是……不再那样看我了吗，还是怎么的？

lines.en: : That’s not it.
lines.zh: : 不是这个原因。

lines.en: : Then what is it? Help me understand.
lines.zh: : 那是什么？帮我弄明白。

lines.en: : If I’m going to keep fucking waiting for you, I’d at least like to know what I’m waiting {i}for.{/i}
lines.zh: : 如果我要一直他妈的等下去，我至少想知道我在等{i}什么{/i}。

lines.en: : It’s not really something that I can easily describe.
lines.zh: : 这事真的不是我能轻易说清楚的。

lines.en: : I just don’t think we should be {i}together{/i} until I feel a little less...numb.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，在我感觉没那么……麻木之前，我们不该{i}在一起{/i}。

lines.en: scene nikilove15
: Ugh. That’ll take years. You’ve been saying that for as long as I’ve known you.
lines.zh: : 呃。那得花好几年。从我认识你起你就一直这么说。

lines.en: : Listen, there’s obviously no rush since I have {i}zero{/i} interest in anyone else, but don’t keep me waiting forever...okay?
lines.zh: : 听着，显然不用急，因为我对别人{i}一点{/i}兴趣都没有，但别让我永远等下去……好吗？

lines.en: : I’m really bad at taking no for an answer, but I love you enough to let it happen every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 我很不擅长接受“不行”这个答案，但我爱你爱到可以偶尔让它发生一次。

lines.en: : I appreciate you accepting that I, too, have free will. That’s very generous of you, Niki.
lines.zh: : 感谢你承认我也拥有自由意志。你真是太慷慨了，Niki。

lines.en: : Don’t get snippy with me, asshole. And get a new fucking blazer, would you? This thing is worn to hell.
lines.zh: : 别跟我顶嘴，混蛋。还有，去他妈的换件新西装外套行吗？这件都穿烂了。

lines.en: : This is a good shirt. You take that back.
lines.zh: : 这是件好衬衫。你收回那句话。

lines.en: scene nikilove16
: So, I’m guessing there’s not much hope in getting you to leave your lame school party and come back to a different, fancier hotel with me?
lines.zh: : 那么，我猜让你离开那个无聊的学校派对、跟我回另一家更高级的酒店，是没什么指望了？

lines.en: : Maybe next time. I’ve already been gone for a while and kind of told someone that I’d meet up with {i}them{/i} next.
lines.zh: : 也许下次吧。我已经离开挺久了，而且刚跟{i}别人{/i}说好接下来要见面。

lines.en: : I’m sorry it wasn’t the result you were looking for, but I {i}am{/i} glad you came here to tell me all of that.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉这不{i}是{/i}你想要的结果，但我很高兴你来这儿跟我说了这些。

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. Whatever. If you’re not going to give my box back, at least try skimming through some of the nicer letters to see if any {i}more{/i} of your memories come back.
lines.zh: : 行吧行吧。随便你。如果你不打算把我的盒子还给我，至少试着翻翻那些比较温柔的信，看看还能不能想起{i}更{/i}多事。

lines.en: : I knew they would eventually. Just didn’t think it would take this fucking long.
lines.zh: : 我早就知道它们迟早会起作用。只是没想到要花他妈的这么久。

lines.en: : I don’t understand how you can still be so accepting of me after all I’ve put you through.
lines.zh: : 我不明白，在我让你受了这么多苦之后，你怎么还能这么接纳我。

lines.en: : The same reason I frantically came over here in the middle of the night to tell you all of this.
lines.zh: : 跟我半夜匆匆赶来跟你说这些的原因一样。

lines.en: : Because I miss you.
lines.zh: : 因为我想你。

lines.en: scene nikilove17
: It’s a shame you didn’t want to come back to my hotel, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你不想跟我回酒店，还真是可惜。

lines.en: : I was thinking tonight could be the night.
lines.zh: : 我本来想着今晚可以就是那个夜晚。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, what was that?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你刚才说什么？

lines.en: scene nikilove18
: Ooooooh, nothing~
: Just that it must really suck to be you right now.
lines.zh: : 只是说，当现在的你一定很惨吧。

lines.en: scene nikilove19
: Feel free to text me if you get bored or something. Maybe I’ll even give you a little peek at what you’re missing out on?
lines.zh: : 无聊了随时给我发短信。也许我还能让你稍微看一眼你错过了什么？

lines.en: : Actually...maybe not. I don’t know how fun it would be since you’re so {i}numb{/i} and all.
lines.zh: : 其实……也许不行。你这么{i}麻木{/i}，谁知道那还有没有意思。

lines.en: : Oh, and get a new blazer! It’s okay to treat yourself on Christmas!
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，换件新西装外套！圣诞节犒劳一下自己也没什么！

lines.en: : Also, I love you!
lines.zh: : 还有，我爱你！

lines.en: : Goodnight!
lines.zh: : 晚安！

lines.en: scene black
Niki’s voice gets harder to hear with each sentence as she distances herself from the hotel.
lines.zh: Niki 一句句地远离酒店，声音也随之越来越难听清。

lines.en: I don’t know if I’d count this as a {i}rejection{/i} if I was her, but I’m sure it didn’t feel good to pour her heart out like that to such a lackluster response.
lines.zh: 如果我是她，我不知道这算不算{i}被拒绝{/i}，但我敢肯定，把心掏出来却得到这么个乏味的回应，感觉不会好受。

lines.en: I am the king of lackluster responses, though.
lines.zh: 不过我可是乏味回应的王者。

lines.en: Just as I’m the king of luring young women into relationships that only I stand to benefit from.
lines.zh: 就像我是那个把年轻女人引诱进只有我一个人受益的关系里的王者一样。

lines.en: But, maybe one day, if I can ever become who it is I am supposed to be-
lines.zh: 但也许有一天，如果我能成为我本该成为的那个人——

lines.en: Or who it is I was-
lines.zh: 或者我曾经是的那个人——

lines.en: Maybe then, that won’t be the case anymore.
lines.zh: 也许到那时，情况就不一样了。
